description: LinkedIn Marketing/Advertising API lets approved partners manage LinkedIn ad campaigns and audiences programmatically.
access_notes: Official docs state explicitly: developers seeking Advertising API permissions 'must be approved' as a LinkedIn Marketing Partner. This is not self-serve at any tier -- you apply for the Advertising API product and go through partner approval before receiving any marketing-related access.
api_notes: Campaign management and audience/reporting endpoints, accessible only once partner-approved.
main_blocker: LinkedIn Marketing Partner approval is required before any Advertising API access is granted -- a significant, explicit partnership gate documented by LinkedIn itself.
